value.title: The Day the World Shattered
value.synopsis: Having lost everything to the "Box of Malice"—those who plot the destruction of the world—Ryddel is pushed to the brink of despair. Refusing to give up, he spends a thousand years becoming a Great Sage and finally succeeds in reversing time using his accumulated knowledge and experience.

value.title: Back to the Past, The First Adventure
value.synopsis: Successfully leaping one thousand years back in time, Ryddel is reunited with Dalsan and Norn, the irreplaceable companions he once lost. Despite his clouded memories immediately following the time-leap, he carries out his quests as an apprentice adventurer.

value.title: The Apprentice With a Thousand Years of Experience
value.synopsis: Ryddel and his companions find themselves cornered by a massive goblin outbreak. Though his body has been rejuvenated, the mana he accumulated over a thousand years is entirely gone. Bewildered by an unprecedented level of weakening, he nevertheless stands his ground, using his knowledge and experience as weapons.

value.title: Ryddel's Resolve
value.synopsis: Defeating the King Goblin in a single blow, Ryddel delivers a flawless performance without letting a single remnant escape. His companions cannot hide their bewilderment at Ryddel's transformation , who was supposed to barely be able to use magic. Clan Leader Rayphon harbors doubts about how Riddle and his team accomplished the quest and launches an investigation.

value.title: Thunder Lord Rhodes
value.synopsis: Accepting a high-difficulty quest out of the kindness of Rhodes the Lightning Flash, Ryddel and his companions advance their investigation of the area. As they cooperate with their allies, suspicions gradually arise regarding the involvement of the "Box of Malice."

value.title: Box of Malice's Footsteps
value.synopsis: Bringing together the information gained from the investigation, they finally locate the opposition group's hideout. Ryddel , wanting to avoid involving his clan mates, proposes turning back for now.

value.title: Mana Perception
value.synopsis: Ryddel and his companions engage in battle with a group of bandits but find themselves forced into a hard fight. Someone is controlling the bandit group from somewhere using magic that manipulates the dead. Ryddel concentrates his mind to trace the caster's presence.

value.title: Lehzef's Trump Card
value.synopsis: Ryddel stands face-to-face with Rezef, the caster of the "Box of Malice." While parrying incoming attacks, Riddle completely overwhelms him using 1,000 years of knowledge and experience. Driven into a corner, Rezef plays his trump card.

value.title: Piercing Through All
value.synopsis: Ryddel is forced completely onto the defensive by the Chimera Marionette's fierce onslaught. Unable to counterattack Rezef, he is pushed into a corner by a devastating blow.

value.title: The Decision to Depart
value.synopsis: Ryddel earned travel funds by completing high-difficulty quests. To gain the power to confront the "Box of Malice," he leaves the clan.

value.title: The Crimson Bull of Wrath
value.synopsis: Ryddel is surrounded by burly men in a carriage heading toward their next destination. It seems that the members of the clan "The Crimson Bull of Wrath" are on their way to the city of Kart by order of the feudal lord.
